name: Ocean University of China
supervisors: Ministry of Education (co-built with the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Shandong and Qingdao governments)

evidence.summary: CASI reports that the marine corrosion and protection defence key laboratory of CSSC’s 725th Research Institute in Qingdao lists OUC among the universities it works with on joint master’s and doctoral training and on research projects.

OUC describes itself as a key comprehensive university run directly by the Ministry of Education and co-built with the Ministry of Natural Resources and the Shandong and Qingdao governments. In 2011 it opened China’s sixth National Secrecy College (国家保密学院), the only one teaching maritime secrecy, with a Qingdao branch of the national secrecy training base; officials of the central secrecy office and the National Administration of State Secrets Protection attended the opening.
